evidence: static declarations; no app startup, rendering, or admission verification
composition: Each service calls setup_patcher_routes and setup_templating; runtime parity is tested separately.

overlays.title: All Overlays
overlays.desc: Live grid of every overlay at once. Useful for spot-checking which scenes are active before you start streaming.

overlays.title: Player A Party
overlays.desc: Sprites, HP bars, and levels. Tall side panel alongside the game.

overlays.title: Player B Party
overlays.desc: Sprites, HP bars, and levels. Tall side panel alongside the game.

overlays.title: Linked Pairs
overlays.desc: Alive pairs as full cards (area + sprites). Dead pairs as a dimmed list below.

overlays.title: Linked Party ★
overlays.desc: Linked pairs where both mons are currently in party — HP bars, levels, area. Primary overlay for active streaming.

overlays.title: Boxed Links
overlays.desc: Alive linked pairs where one or both mons are currently in the PC box. Auto-scrolls when the list overflows the overlay height.

overlays.title: Enemy Focus · A
overlays.desc: Active enemy(ies) for wild or trainer battles — sprite, HP, status, stat stages, 4-move grid with live PP.

overlays.title: Enemy Focus · B
overlays.desc: Active enemy(ies) for wild or trainer battles — sprite, HP, status, stat stages, 4-move grid with live PP.

overlays.title: Enemy Trainer · A
overlays.desc: Trainer's full enemy team in compact PARTY-style rows. Auto-scrolls when the list overflows. Hidden during wild encounters.

overlays.title: Enemy Trainer · B
overlays.desc: Trainer's full enemy team in compact PARTY-style rows. Auto-scrolls when the list overflows. Hidden during wild encounters.

overlays.title: Focus Card — Player A
overlays.desc: Active battle mon hero card: sprite, HP, status, stat stages, 4-move grid with PP bars.

overlays.title: Focus Card — Player B
overlays.desc: Active battle mon hero card: sprite, HP, status, stat stages, 4-move grid with PP bars.

overlays.title: Death Counter
overlays.desc: Alive / dead pair counts with glow. Scales to any size — great for a corner badge.

overlays.title: Attempts Counter
overlays.desc: Manual run attempt counter with glow. Set the number via the dashboard or API.

overlays.title: Memorial Scroll
overlays.desc: Chronological scrolling list of all dead pairs with sprites. Auto-scrolls when content exceeds height.

overlays.title: Gym Badges — Player A
overlays.desc: Player A's earned gym badges. Unearned badges are dimmed.

overlays.title: Gym Badges — Player B
overlays.desc: Player B's earned gym badges. Unearned badges are dimmed.

overlays.title: Area Tracker
overlays.desc: Linked / dead zone / pending area counts at a glance.

overlays.title: Event Feed
overlays.desc: Live feed of captures, faints, area entries, and soul link events.

overlays.title: Encounter Tracker
overlays.desc: Total encounters, shiny count, and last linked encounter pair.

overlays.title: Event Ticker
overlays.desc: Horizontally scrolling marquee of recent events. Place at the bottom of the stream.

overlays.title: Wild Encounters — Player A
overlays.desc: Encounter rates for Player A's current area (Radical Red only). Walking / Surfing / Fishing with species, rate %, level range.

overlays.title: Wild Encounters — Player B
overlays.desc: Encounter rates for Player B's current area (Radical Red only). Walking / Surfing / Fishing with species, rate %, level range.

overlays.title: Area Encounter
overlays.desc: Soul Link status for the current area: linked pair, pending captures, or dead zone. Auto-follows the most active area.
